findings: Font size dead restore path: $(document).ready in user.js reads localStorage.getItem('persys_font_size') and can overwrite the DB-persisted slider value for users with a stale localStorage key from a prior codebase version. Remove the persys_font_size restore since font size is already server-persisted.

Eye-toggle non-functional: userProfile.php has data-password="" after the hash removal fix. The eye icon reveal sets textContent to an empty string — the button does nothing. Remove it or wire it to the change-password flow.

Weekday counter UTC parse: countWeekdays() constructs Date objects from ISO strings (UTC midnight). In timezones behind UTC this shifts the local day, producing an off-by-one total_leave_days that the server inserts without re-validating. Fix by using new Date(y, m-1, d) with split parts to force local-time construction.
